reason: nothingprojector.com, the host Awin credits, is NothingProjector's European store. Its own Official Stores page lists it as 'Europe: nothingprojector.com', next to 'Global: global.nothingprojector.com' and 'Brazil: brazil.nothingprojector.com'. On 2026-11-17 it priced everything in euros for a visitor it tagged as US (region_country=US). Its products.json shows EUR amounts, for example the Shore Smart Matte Flip cabinet at 1559.00, which is €1.559,00 on the page; the maker's US store sells it at $1,899. The site has no /en-us market (it returns 404, while /en-ca exists), and its banner reads '100% All-Inclusive EU Shipping | No Hidden VAT or Customs Fees'. US shoppers are served in USD by global.nothingprojector.com, a different host that the brief says our Awin links do not credit. So there is no US product on the credited host that I can record.

If Awin confirms that global.nothingprojector.com credits, rerun with that store host. READY-MADE PAGE PLAN FOR A RERUN. Query: 'ust projector cabinet'. Variants: 'tv stand for ust projector', 'motorized ust projector cabinet', 'laser tv cabinet', 'tv stand for short throw projector', 'media console for ust projector'. The search results are thin: mostly store listings and brand blogs from AWOL, XGIMI and Povison, and no independent roundup. Segments and winners, using prices seen 2026-11-17 through storecheck search: (1) The cheapest motorized cabinet that also houses a 100-120 inch floor-rising screen. Winner: the Shore 100-120 inch Black Motorized Laser TV Flat Pack Cabinet at $1,799 (compare $4,189) on global.nothingprojector.com/products/flat-pack-laser-tv-cabinet-for-ultra-short-throw-laser-projector. The same cabinet costs $1,999 at the maker, shorelivings.com. It measures 98.43 W x 22.83 D x 14.69 H in, the drawer interior is 35.24 x 14.76 x 8.54 in, it ships flat-pack, and each shelf holds about 25 kg. (2) A wall-screen owner who wants the lowest price. Winner: AWOL Vision Smart Cabinet at $1,200 (compare $3,999), with a motorized height lift. It comes in 100-inch-only or 120-inch-only versions, measures 86.61 in wide x 18.11 or 20.87 in deep, has a 90-working-day lead time and is 'Designed for LTV Series'. It is sold only on AWOL's own store, so it would get a plain maker link. (3) A buyer who wants the projector fully hidden inside a closed cabinet. Candidate: VIVIDSTORM (our approved CJ brand), whose motorized cabinets start with the Barcelona Mark III at $3,199 (compare $4,499); I did not confirm it hides the projector fully. The VIVIDSTORM Berlin Epson and Leica editions are $3,299. More rival prices: AWOL Vanish Cabinet 2.0 at $3,499, Vanish 1.0 cabinet at $1,450, and CINEST Core E1/A1 at $3,699-4,499 on projectorscreen.com. PAIN POINTS, with counts across about 8 sources (thin: mostly vendor blogs plus one hands-on review and two forum threads): standard consoles are too shallow, 15-18 in versus about 16-17 in (42 cm) needed for a 120 inch image (5); alignment has to be redone after the stand is bumped, or a wobbly DIY tray throws it off (3); heavy, hard delivery and assembly, with missing manuals and parts that differ from the video (3: Laurent Willen review, Povison reviewer, Shore 100 kg+ in 5 boxes); drawer and remote electronics glitches (2: the Willen remote lost sync, a Povison owner called the electronics 'mostly wonky'); the projector doesn't fit the drawer, for example a Samsung Premiere 9 in a Povison 86 inch (1); no cancellation or refund on Shore cabinet orders (1, from the Shore Livings listing); long lead times, 90 working days at AWOL (1). UNVERIFIED: I could not open any global.nothingprojector.com product page because of HTTP 429, so its prices come only from the store search. I don't know the US shipping fee or lead time for the Shore cabinet, its drawer travel distance, or what the 'NPBF' Black Friday code takes off; the EU page shows 'CODE: NPBF' with 'From €400' and no terms. No network codes were supplied. Hometechnologyreview.com, which covered the Shore cabinet, returned HTTP 403.
